scenario: In a park, the protagonist is trying to help people who do not know each other start a relaxed conversation. The scene centers on low-pressure social icebreaking. 场景目标：The interaction should end with the group feeling more comfortable and having a simple shared topic or next activity.

identities.identity_summary: Jason Miller is a 25-year-old community volunteer trying to help a small park group warm up socially.
identities.what_they_do: He introduces people, notices who is quiet, and keeps the conversation easy to join.
identities.base_goal: Create a relaxed opening so everyone can say something without feeling forced.

identities.identity_summary: Hannah Lee is a 24-year-old new resident attending the park activity for the first time.
identities.what_they_do: She responds cautiously and looks for signs that the group is welcoming.
identities.base_goal: Join the conversation at a comfortable pace without feeling exposed.

identities.identity_summary: Marcus Hill is a 31-year-old local resident who already knows the park well.
identities.what_they_do: He offers casual local context and helps the conversation feel grounded.
identities.base_goal: Make the new person feel welcome while keeping the conversation natural.
